title: Contact
intro: GlassFolio is an independent project, built and maintained by one person. This page tells you where to send what, so that your message reaches the right place.

privacy.title: Your data and privacy
privacy.body: To access, correct, export or erase your personal data, or to ask a question about privacy, write to the address below. The Privacy Policy explains what is stored and how your rights apply.

issues.title: Bugs and feature requests
issues.body: Open an issue on GitHub. Say what you did, what you expected and what happened, and mention the version shown on the changelog page. Never put a password, a recovery key or financial data in a public issue.

security.title: Security concerns
security.body: If you think you found a vulnerability, please do not open a public issue. Write to the privacy address with the subject “Security” and describe how to reproduce it.
security.subject: Security

project.title: The project and its author
project.body: To know who builds GlassFolio and how, read the About page. The roadmap and the changelog show what is coming and what has changed.

limits.title: Good to know
limits.body: Replies are written by hand, so please allow some time. GlassFolio gives no personalised tax, legal or investment advice and cannot answer questions about your own tax return: for those, turn to a qualified professional or to the tax administration.
